t: A browser simulator of an Arduino Uno for writing and testing sketches.
steps: Open the Coddy Arduino Playground page in a web browser.
Write a short sketch that blinks an LED.
Open the serial monitor and print a message.
Try the distance sensor example from the snippets.
Test a servo sketch with the Servo library.
Read the Coddy terms and privacy pages before students use it.
Decide whether to add a physical board later.
